market.summary: Fragmented Arabic/French academic and research sector, ministry/public networks, national deposit library and foundation/cultural-institute libraries. PMB is the strongest observed reusable family; Koha has promising but currently unreachable major endpoints. National/public shared services offer greater strategic reach but no verified multi-library book response in this run.
market.platform_strategy: Pilot site-specific PMB adaptations with CJB/INAU only as reserves; GLB Saïs is a substantial isolated candidate with data-quality and encoding risks. Reassess official IMIST/Ibn Tofail Koha policy/connectivity before adapter reuse. Investigate CBM and Ministry shared service when accessible rather than treating repositories/journal unions as holdings.

limitations: No national largest-ten ranking established; dated volumes, titles, capacity, documents and space proxies are not comparable.

Public searches establish bibliographic presence, not visitor admission, home borrowing eligibility, reuse licence or reliable live circulation.
No app adapter/live app tests, authentication, holds, outreach, TLS/bot bypass or deployment.
502/503/tunnel failures are observations from this environment on2026-11-15, not proof that libraries are offline or lack a book.
USMBA Arabic query failed while French query succeeded; Arabic/French/Amazigh identity and encoding need broader validation.
USMBA homepage has contradictory copy totals on unrelated cards; selected record happens to show1 total/1 available.
Most institutional size claims are undated or old; none establishes national rank.
CJB anonymous CSRF field must be reacquired with a fresh in-memory session; ephemeral token values are redacted in retained evidence.
Discovery JSON files are search-source evidence only; no search-index title is counted as a catalogue success.
The AUI linked JavaScript evidence is deliberately truncated at1.5MB; no endpoint availability claim derives from it.
